overview: S05 is a one-field world-metadata write (the spawn BlockPos) with no serverbound counterpart and no timing, position or input signal, so no anticheat consumes it. The corpus is two registrations: Negativity's PacketType SPAWN_POSITION constant and Artemis PacketRepository's SERVER_PLAY + 71 mapping to PacketPlayServerSpawnPosition, plus the Artemis packet interface itself. checks: [] reflects the corpus: nothing in any of the 50 anticheats reads the spawn position from this packet, and its only downstream effect (the compass) has no anti-cheat relevance.
